plan.title: Double-click Publish creates one RFQ event

steps.note: Opens the single-stage event creation flow.
Ensures vendors can be added during event creation as required by the case.
Sets the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provides the mandatory event title while allowing the runner to generate a unique title for later list verification.
Applies the RFQ template so the pricing sheet is rendered.
Adds the specified product and quantity to the RFQ.
Verifies that the product's mapped default variant is filled automatically.
Verifies the requested quantity entered for the product.
Selects the required delivery location in the pricing sheet.
Confirms the selected delivery location is retained.
Adds one QA test vendor, corresponding to the case's Vendor A participant.
Commits the required Start now, 30-minute schedule.
Publishes the completed RFQ; this is the closest available action to the requested publish confirmation, but it performs only one publish action.
Confirms the event was created and the buyer reached its project page.
Returns to the Events list to verify the created event is discoverable.
Confirms the Events list rendered successfully before searching for the created event.
Verifies that the event created by this plan appears in the Events list.
